payload.posture: Read Genesis 42:18–24 as one movement in Joseph's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states joseph offers a path to life, hears the brothers connect distress to their treatment of him, turns aside to weep, and binds Simeon. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Joseph's story.
